brief.what: Interactive property siteplan with unit pins wired to live Entrata PMS rent and availability — not a static PDF or third-party embed.
brief.benefits: Prospect Portal · Leasing Websites · Open API pricing feed
brief.why_build: Counters Jonah/Engrain SightMap-style embeds with the one thing they structurally cannot ship: pricing that updates when the PMS updates.

roi.summary: Live unit pricing on the siteplan lifts high-intent apply starts; delta is PMS-tied map UX, not a static embed.

numbers.formula: (Δ apply-start rate × avg monthly rent × vacancy days avoided per start) ÷ units
inputs: +0.5–1.0% lift on siteplan sessions that reach apply (roi-analyst midpoint)
$1,800 blended avg rent · 3 vacancy days avoided per incremental start
Vacancy-day cost ≈ daily rent (industry norm — not client-specific)
numbers.scaling: Per-unit annual → ×250 for single-property chunk → ×10,000 for portfolio chunk. Portfolio figure is a directional scale, not a forecast.
numbers.disclaimer: Modeled approximation for prioritization — not measured client ROI or a finance sign-off number.

brief.advantage: Jonah/Engrain ship static or partner feeds; Entrata pins read the same live rent engine that powers leasing — no middleware lag.
brief.why_pursue: High-intent shoppers self-serve on the map; every day of stale pricing is a lost tour slot and extra vacancy days.

brief.what: Mobile in-tour workflow for leasing agents — capture photos, voice notes, and push-to-apply links tied to the unit record in Entrata PMS.
brief.benefits: Leasing CRM · Prospect Portal · Screening · Maintenance (unit-tied tickets)
brief.why_build: EliseAI's Agent CRM stops at chat; this is what happens on the property floor with PMS, screening, and maintenance in one path.

roi.summary: In-tour capture + push-to-apply off mobile frees ~0.3 agent hrs/unit/mo on follow-up; Entrata-owned PMS path competitors cannot copy.

numbers.formula: (agent hours saved per unit per month × loaded leasing labor rate × 12) ÷ units
inputs: ~0.3 agent hrs/unit/mo saved on post-tour follow-up (photo + apply link + voice note vs desk work)
$32/hr loaded leasing labor (benchmark chunk — varies by market)
Assumes 1 agent covers ~80 units; savings compound at portfolio scale
numbers.scaling: Per-unit capacity value → ×250 property → ×10,000 portfolio. Capacity dollars, not new rent — frees agents to close more tours.
numbers.disclaimer: Modeled approximation from labor-capacity benchmarks — not a time-motion study or payroll audit.

brief.advantage: EliseAI owns the conversation layer, not the PMS — they cannot attach photos to unit records, push live apply pricing, or spawn maintenance tickets in one tap.
brief.why_pursue: Tour-to-apply drop-off is highest in the first hour after a walk; field capture closes that gap before the agent gets back to the desk.
